title: PNP logs 8 cybercrime convictions, 144 referred cases in October

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) recorded eight cybercrime convictions and 144 referred cases that involved various online offenses for the month of October. According to the PNP, the eight recorded convictions reflected its sustained efforts to prevent cyber-related criminal acts. Meanwhile, the PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group also logged 144 referred cases that involved fraudulent transactions, misuse of digital platforms, and online disputes. Of the figures, 34 were online libel cases, which is the highest number accounted for. At least 25 cases involved estafa or violations of Article 315 (swindling) of the Revised Penal Code.
